login.title: Your events,
login.lead: Sign in with your email. We'll send you a 6-digit code, no password needed.
login.emailHeading: Sign in or create an account
login.noPassword: No password to remember. New here? This creates your account.
login.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
login.previewBody: Email isn't set up on this deployment. Your code is
login.reauth: For security, please sign in again to continue.

dashboard.title: Every
dashboard.emptyBody: Create an event, print the QR cards and every guest's photos land in one private album.
dashboard.accountBody: Signed in as {email}. Deleting your account removes the events you own and every photo in them.

wizard.titleHint: Guests see this on the QR card and in the album.
wizard.daysHint: Spread over more than one day? Add up to {max} days, each with its own section in the album.
wizard.doneBody: Print the QR cards and try it out with a few test uploads. When you're happy, pay {price} to open the gallery to your guests.
wizard.doneWindow: Your gallery is set to open on {from} and close on {to}. You can change this in Settings until it opens.
wizard.doneNoWindow: Pick when your gallery opens and closes in Settings, then pay to open it to your guests.
wizard.windowHint: Guests can join and upload between these times, for up to {days} days. We start it at 10:00 on the event date; you can change it any time until it opens.

occasion.archived: This event's files were deleted at the end of its storage period.

album.title: Album
album.pendingBody: are waiting for approval. Once approved they appear in the live feed and on the wall.
album.emptyHint: Print the QR cards or share the link. Guest photos appear here as they upload.
album.confirmDelete: Delete {n} shot(s) for good? This can't be undone.
album.duplicatesHint: These look almost identical to another shot. Nothing is deleted automatically.
album.blurryHint: These look out of focus. Nothing is deleted automatically.
album.confirmHideMatching: Hide all of them? You can show them again from Hidden.
album.hiddenMatching: Hidden. You'll find them under Hidden.
album.confirmBlock: Block this guest? Their shots will be hidden and their phone can't upload again.
album.processingLong: This video is still being prepared. It will play in a moment.

qr.title: QR cards
qr.lead: Print table cards (four A6 cards per A4 sheet) or an A4 poster for the entrance. The copy is in both languages.
qr.cardsHint: Print at 100% scale on A4, then cut along the dashed lines.
qr.posterHint: Print at 100% scale on A4. Thicker paper looks best.
qr.headline: Share your
qr.body: Scan the QR code to add your photos and videos to our album. No app needed.

share.title: Share links for family abroad
share.lead: Send a private link so family who couldn't be there can see the album, and add their own photos if you allow it.
share.label: Who is it for?
share.confirmRevoke: Revoke this link? Anyone using it loses access.
share.guestMessage: Join us at {title}! Open this link to add your photos and videos to our album, no app needed: {url}

team.title: Co-hosts
team.lead: Co-hosts can see, moderate and download the whole album.
team.invited: Invite sent. They join when they sign in with that email.

settings.linkHint: Choose an easy link name for invitations. The original link keeps working too.
settings.coverHint: Shown on the guest welcome screen, the live wall and the QR cards.
settings.coverFailed: We couldn't use that photo. Try a JPEG or PNG.
settings.daysHint: Add up to {max} days. Each day can have its own QR code and upload times.
settings.dayLocked: Guests can't see this day (only the first {max} days are shown).
settings.closesHint: Leave empty to keep them open.
settings.approval: Approve shots before guests see them
settings.approvalHint: New shots wait in the album until you approve them.
settings.revealAtHint: Empty = 9:00 the morning after the event date.
settings.shotsHint: Leave empty to turn the camera off. Disposable shots develop the next morning.
settings.pinOn: Guests need the PIN to join.
settings.pinOff: No PIN. Anyone with the link or QR can join.

danger.title: Delete event
danger.body: Deletes the event, every photo, video and message for good. Download anything you want to keep first.
danger.confirmPrompt: Type the event title to confirm: {title}
danger.mismatch: The title didn't match, so nothing was deleted.

missions.title: Photo
missions.lead: Give guests little missions to snap. They see the list in the guest app and race up the leaderboard.
missions.empty: No challenges yet. Add one or pick an idea.
missions.ideas: Selfie with the couple|Your whole table, one frame|Best dance move|The oldest and youngest guest together|Someone crying happy tears|A 10-second video message|The best outfit|A toast to the hosts

guestbook.title: Guest
guestbook.leadVoice: Written, voice and video messages from your guests. Only hosts can see them.
guestbook.emptyHint: Guests can leave a message from the Book tab in the guest app.

download.title: Download
download.lead: Original-quality files, straight from storage to your computer ({size} in total).
download.everythingHint: One ZIP with every photo and video.
download.everythingHintDays: One ZIP with a folder per day.
download.keepOpen: Keep this tab open until it finishes.
download.failed: The download stopped. Please try again.
download.browserNote: Big albums download best in Chrome or Edge on a computer, which save straight to disk.
download.lockedSetup: Downloads open once you've paid for the event. Until then you can view everything in the album.
download.lockedRefunded: This event was refunded, so downloads are closed.
download.lockedExpired: This event's files have been deleted.
download.lockedSuspended: This account is suspended, so downloads are closed. Please contact support.
download.bigHint: That's {size}: download one day at a time below for the most reliable result.

support.title: How can we
support.lead: Questions about your event, a payment or your account? Email us and a real person replies.
support.reply: We usually reply within one working day.
support.faq: Do guests need an app?::No. Guests scan the QR code and upload from their phone's browser. The app is optional, mainly for hosts.|How much does it cost?::{price} per event, paid once. Setting up is free, and you can test it with up to {testLimit} uploads of your own before you pay.|How long are photos kept?::While the gallery is live and for {retentionMonths} months after it ends. We email you when it ends, and again 30 and 7 days before anything is deleted.|Can I get a refund?::Yes. Email us from the address you signed up with any time before your gallery goes live and we'll refund you in full.|Who can see the photos?::Only the hosts and co-hosts see the full album. Guests see the shared feed, and you can approve shots first.

accountDelete.title: Delete your account
accountDelete.lead: You can delete your account and its data at any time.
accountDelete.points: Events you own are deleted, with every photo, video and message|You're removed from events where you are a co-host|Your sign-in email and app notification tokens are deleted|Payment records are kept by Stripe as the law requires
accountDelete.guests: Guests don't have accounts. To remove photos you uploaded as a guest, open the event and use "My uploads", or ask the hosts.
accountDelete.confirm: This can't be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.
accountDelete.orEmail: Or email {email} from the address on your account.

code.subject: {code} is your {brand} code
code.heading: Your sign-in code
code.body: Type this code in the window where you asked for it.
code.ignore: Didn't ask for this? You can ignore this email.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {title}
invite.heading: You're a co-host of {title}
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to help host {title} on {brand}. Sign in with this email address to see the album.
invite.footer: You got this email because someone added your address as a co-host.

report.subject: A guest reported a photo in {title}
report.heading: A photo was reported
report.body: A guest reported a photo in {title}. It's hidden from the feed until you review it.
report.footer: You got this email because you host this event.

ended.subject: Your {title} gallery has ended: download everything
ended.heading: Your gallery has ended
ended.body: Guest uploads for {title} are now closed. Every photo and video is ready for you to download in full quality, as one ZIP or one per day.
ended.body2: Your files are kept until {date}. Download them before then and keep a copy somewhere safe.
ended.body2NoDate: Download them soon and keep a copy somewhere safe.
ended.footer: You got this email because you host this event on {brand}.

deletionSoon.subject: {title}: your photos will be deleted on {date}
deletionSoon.heading: Your files will be deleted soon
deletionSoon.body: The photos, videos and messages from {title} will be deleted on {date}, in {days} days.
deletionSoon.body2: Download everything now if you haven't already. After that date they can't be recovered.

readOnly.locked: Uploads are closed for this event and it can't be edited right now. Please contact support.
readOnly.suspended: This account is suspended, so its events are read-only. Please contact support.
readOnly.refunded: This event was refunded, so it's read-only and guests can't open it.
readOnly.expired: This event's files were deleted at the end of its storage period.

dialog.title: Downloads open once you've paid
dialog.body: Pay {price} for this event to download every original and ZIP, and to open the gallery to your guests.
dialog.cohost: Downloads open once the event owner has paid for the event.

window.title: Gallery dates
window.hint: Guests can join and upload while the gallery is live: up to {days} days, between the times you choose. You can change them until the gallery opens.
window.timeZoneHint: Times are in this zone. Guests see them in the same zone.
window.lockedLive: The gallery is live, so its dates are fixed. You can end it early if you need to.
window.lockedEnded: The gallery has ended. Guest uploads are closed.
window.endConfirm: End the gallery now? Guests won't be able to add photos after this, and it can't be undone.
window.ended: The gallery has ended. We'll email you a download link.

pay.checkoutNote: Full refund if you cancel before your gallery goes live. Your gallery opens and closes on the dates you chose.
pay.ownerOnly: Only the event owner can pay for it.
pay.paidNotice: Thank you, your payment went through. It can take a moment to show here.
pay.fine: One-off payment, VAT included. Card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Full refund if you cancel before the gallery goes live.

package.setupBody: Guests can't join yet: they'll see when the gallery opens. Print your QR cards and try it with up to {limit} test uploads of your own ({used} used so far).
package.setupNoDates: Pick when your gallery opens and closes, then pay to open it to your guests.
package.paidBody: Guests who scan the QR code before then see when the gallery opens. You can still add photos yourself and change the dates until it opens.
package.liveBody: Guests can join and upload now. When the gallery closes we'll email you a link to download everything.
package.endedBody: Guest uploads are closed and guests can still look. Download every photo and video in full quality any time before {date}.
package.expiredBody: This event's photos and videos were deleted at the end of its storage period.
package.refundedBody: This event was refunded, so it's read-only and guests can't open it. You can delete it in Settings.
package.comped: Our team has covered this event for you.
package.testBanner: Test mode: only you and your co-hosts can upload ({used} of {limit}). Guests see “opens soon” until you pay and the gallery opens.
package.cohostPay: The event owner can pay to open the gallery.
